title: fix(multicursor): edit applied twice at cursor overlapping the primary
body:
Problem:
A cursor overlapping the primary is deduped by comparing positions at the clock edge, i.e. after the primary edit executed. But "replace" at the cursor cell (`rx`, `~`, `g~iw`) shifts the overlapping extmark, so it is not caught as a duplicate. Thus `vipQg~~` applies twice to the 2nd line.

Solution:
Decide "overlaps the primary" at cmd start, before the edit.

fix #42025
